documents.title: Nifty IT index loses 3,000 pts in last five sessions; should you 'sell on rise'?
documents.summary: Report from 25 Feb 2026: the Nifty IT index fell over 3,000 points (about 9%) in five sessions and was down about 21% for 2026 so far. The article links the fall to fears that AI tools could cut demand for IT services, broker downgrades of six Indian IT stocks, and tariff worries.

documents.title: India Imposes Safeguard Duty For 3 Years on Certain Steel Products
documents.summary: Report of 31 Dec 2025: India set a three-year safeguard duty on certain steel flat products to shield domestic producers from a sharp rise in low-priced imports. The duty is 12% in year one (from 21 Apr 2025), 11.5% in year two and 11% in year three.

documents.title: Nifty Metal Jumps Over 3%; SAIL, Hindustan Copper Lead - Here's What Happened
documents.summary: Report from 13 May 2026: the Nifty Metal index rose by up to about 3.2% in a day, with SAIL, Hindustan Copper, Vedanta and NMDC leading. The article points to a higher import duty on gold and silver, a steel safeguard duty, and record copper prices on tight global supply.

documents.title: Recommendations of the 56th Meeting of the GST Council
documents.publisher: Press Information Bureau, Government of India
documents.summary: Official release of 3 Sep 2025. GST moves to two main rates (5% and 18%) from 22 Sep 2025. Small cars and motorcycles up to 350 cc fall from 28% to 18%; many packaged foods, shampoo, toothpaste and soap move to 5%; TVs and air-conditioners fall to 18%.

documents.title: Monetary and Credit Information Review, December 2025
documents.summary: RBI publication of Dec 2025. It records that the Monetary Policy Committee unanimously cut the repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.25% in December 2025 and kept a neutral stance. CPI inflation for 2025-26 was projected at 2.0%.

documents.title: Sensex settles 2,073 pts higher; Nifty ends above 25,700 level
documents.summary: Market report of 3 Feb 2026: Sensex and Nifty 50 closed about 2.5% higher after an India-US trade deal was announced. The US would lower tariffs on Indian goods to 18% and drop the extra 25% penalty linked to India's Russian crude purchases. Realty, financial services and consumer durables stocks led.
